per_prediction.description: There is a lack of comprehensive evaluation of different graph construction strategies for high-cardinality categorical features in fraud detection, as seen in GraphFC's reframing of graph construction strategies.

The integration of real-time fraud detection with adaptive GNNs and federated learning is an emerging area, but specific methodologies and their effectiveness under varying real-time constraints are not thoroughly explored.

The comparative evaluation of GNNs and traditional machine learning methods under specific regulatory and compliance constraints, such as those in Nigeria, is limited, as seen in the comparison between GraphSAGE and XGBoost.
The effectiveness of frequency-aware mechanisms in GFD is not fully explored, especially in the context of real-time fraud detection and dynamic financial networks.
